headline: RapWire 24/7: Cordae, Lil Baby, Gucci Mane, ScHoolboy Q, and GTA VI
body: RapWire's verified Oct. 18 morning carousel covers Cordae's MMMG lawsuit, Lil Baby's Fresh rollout, Gucci Mane's Against All Odds, ScHoolboy Q's THank Que confirmation, and Rockstar's GTA VI culture reset. Each slide uses original subject-led late-1980s editorial comic art with complete on-art reporting, no top banner, and the official transparent RapWire mark.
rendered_body_text: RapWire's verified Oct. 18 morning carousel covers Cordae's MMMG lawsuit, Lil Baby's Fresh rollout, Gucci Mane's Against All Odds, ScHoolboy Q's THank Que confirmation, and Rockstar's GTA VI culture reset. Each slide uses original subject-led late-1980s editorial comic art with complete on-art reporting, no top banner, and the official transparent RapWire mark.
caption:
1) MMMG filed a federal lawsuit against Cordae, EMPIRE, Apeshit and Mass Appeal, alleging a 2018 recording deal still covers his music. The complaint seeks at least $25 million across contract and copyright claims and asks the court to stop the October 23 release of Heavy Is the Crown with Anderson .Paak. No judge has ruled on the claims or granted an injunction. @cordae
2) Lil Baby has set his next album, Fresh, for November 6 and shared a 17-song tracklist tease. Future and Young Thug are listed on “All My Patnas,” Rylo Rodriguez appears on “In Your Head,” and Pharrell-produced “Dead Fresh” is also on the board. The date turns a long-teased project into a defined rollout for @lilbaby_1.
3) Gucci Mane released Against All Odds on October 16 through 1017 and Atlantic Music Group. The 17-track album is his 18th studio LP and features Summer Walker, OJ da Juiceman and Ice Davis, extending a catalog that has shaped Atlanta trap for more than two decades. @gucci1017
4) ScHoolboy Q told fans that his 12-song album THank Que is coming in 2027 while celebrating the tenth anniversary of Blank Face LP on tour. He also promised he will still be around for the record's twentieth anniversary, making the announcement both a release update and a clear retirement rebuttal. @groovyq
5) Rockstar says it changed how GTA VI is made after the long-hours culture surrounding Red Dead Redemption 2. Head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe described paid time off or added pay for extra hours, while the studio continues tuning the build for its November 19 launch. The shift matters because GTA VI is Rockstar's biggest public test of that workplace reset.

@Rapwire247

slide_editorial_copy.headline: CORDAE'S ALBUM AT RISK?
slide_editorial_copy.deck: MMMG's New York federal suit alleges Cordae's 2018 deal still controls his recordings and seeks to block Heavy Is the Crown before its October 23 release. The complaint names EMPIRE, Apeshit and Mass Appeal; no injunction has been granted.

slide_editorial_copy.headline: LIL BABY SETS FRESH
slide_editorial_copy.deck: Lil Baby sets Fresh for November 6 with 17 teased songs, including Future and Young Thug on “All My Patnas” and Rylo Rodriguez on “In Your Head.” The rollout gives the Atlanta rapper's next era a confirmed date.

slide_editorial_copy.headline: GUCCI STAYS AGAINST ALL ODDS
slide_editorial_copy.deck: Against All Odds is Gucci Mane's 17-track, 18th studio album, released October 16 through 1017/Atlantic. Summer Walker, OJ da Juiceman and Ice Davis guest on the veteran's latest Atlanta trap chapter.

slide_editorial_copy.headline: Q WILL NEVER RETIRE
slide_editorial_copy.deck: ScHoolboy Q says his 12-song THank Que is coming in 2027 after he revived the project during the Blank Face LP anniversary tour. The TDE veteran also told fans he will never retire.

slide_editorial_copy.headline: ROCKSTAR REWRITES THE RULES
slide_editorial_copy.deck: Rockstar says GTA VI's team changed its work culture after Red Dead Redemption 2's crunch. Extra hours can mean paid time off or added pay, and the build is still being tuned for November 19.
